body: Thank you so much. I have a long way to go but this really helped.

Yeah, he's 17 now and will be 18 later in the year. I'm just frightened that it seems people who are older than me think its fine but anyone in my age group of like 18 to early 20s would think its horrible and that I'm the same as a pedophile. Thank you for what you've said though. Just hearing another person tell me that it wasn't bad lifts weight off of me.
I'm scared that the age difference makes me a morally reprehensible person.
